summary: Comprehensive testing of Website Projects page and Theme Toggle feature completed. Backend: 17/17 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All features working correctly including project creation, status updates, phase tracking, page management, and theme toggle.
critical_code_review_comments: WebsiteProjectsPage.js is well-structured at 840 lines with proper component decomposition (PhaseCell component)
website_projects_routes.py is clean at 496 lines with proper CRUD operations and auto-status calculation
ThemeContext.js properly implements light/dark/system theme with localStorage persistence
All API endpoints properly exclude MongoDB _id field
Proper use of data-testid attributes for testability
Good use of isDark from ThemeContext for consistent theming across components
seed_data_creation: Created test projects via E2E testing - E2E Test Project with custom page
context_for_next_testing_agent: Website Projects feature fully implemented and tested. Features: 1) Spreadsheet-like view for website development projects, 2) Phase progress tracking (Wireframe, UI, Content, Dev), 3) Default 8 pages created per project, 4) Custom page addition, 5) Status dropdowns for each phase with auto-calculation of overall status, 6) Project tabs sidebar for switching between projects, 7) Search and filter functionality, 8) Light/Dark/System theme toggle working across all pages. NO MOCKED APIs - using real MongoDB backend.
